lede: Illinois carries the stronger underlying team rating — +1.4 against -1.4, a 2.8-point separation on a neutral field before home advantage, travel or rest.
EdgeDesk makes it Illinois -7.7 before any sportsbook number is consulted, with Illinois winning 69% of simulations.
The position-group comparison shows where the separation comes from: the widest measured gap is offense, where Illinois leads Duke by 68 places nationally.
Data confidence on this matchup is 41% — enough to publish, not enough to treat the exact margin as settled.
